verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents its own Web API (webapi.teamviewer.com/api/v1/docs), and its pricing page lists API access alongside auditability. Nothing in the evidence shows how much of the UI's functionality the API covers, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage of UI features such as remote sessions, device management, monitoring, scripting and AI features; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; independent or hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity.
